description: Build home screen with carousels in SwiftUI (iOS + tvOS). Implement hero carousel with auto-advance using TabView/PageView, category rows with LazyHStack, continue watching section, watchlist integration. tvOS version: 10-foot UI with focus-based navigation. iOS version: compact layouts for iPhone/iPad with swipe gestures. Fetch data from Rust SDK.
title: Phase 3.3: iOS/tvOS Home Screen with Carousels
